text: LangGraph builds workflows using state, nodes, and edges.
Sentence embeddings represent text as vectors that capture meaning.
RAG retrieves relevant documents before generating an answer.
LangChain connects language models to prompts, retrievers, and tools so you can build the application.
LangSmith traces each run and evaluates output quality, so you can see why an answer failed.
A checkpoint is saved state that lets a LangGraph run be resumed later when persistence is configured.
